description: Landslide and flash floods impact analysis in Umdloti village, eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20220418ZAF This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides/mudflow in Umdloti village, eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal Province, South Africa as observed from a NewSat image acquired on 13 April 2022. Within the analyzed area, 14 buildings appear to be affected and 13 are potentially affected. Affected roads were also identified. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-10-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
